story.heading: Always means we will get you in
paragraphs: People skip the dentist when booking feels like a project. We keep the phone on the page and the next step obvious.
Come in for the cleaning. Stay for the work you have been postponing. We will sequence it so it fits your month.
Always Dental Care serves people who live and work in Phoenixville.
You'll find the phone and the next step on this page, not buried in a menu.
Come in when you're ready. We'll make the visit straightforward.

items: Pick a morning or after work
Leave with the next date set
experience.heading: How a visit goes

feature.heading: Egypt Road, Suite 210
feature.text: Phoenixville patients should not need a downtown trip for everyday dentistry. We keep the visits local and the explanations short.

spotlight.heading: 1570 Egypt Road
spotlight.text: Suite 210 is easy to find. Call if you want the first or last slot of the day.

contact.heading: Put it on the calendar
contact.sub: Call the office. Tell us if you are new or if you are coming back after a while. Either is fine.
